'''Grandma Hua''' is an elderly female NPC found at {{Location|Taoyuan Vale}}. She is formally from Qichi Village, which was abandoned after an incident long ago.<ref>[[Ominous Star]]</ref>

She can be found at daytime, on the bridge heading towards Clouded Cliffs.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Grandma Hua:''' Farming and watering the crops... The life here is the best.
:'''Grandma Hua:''' It's peaceful and comfortable when you have everything worked out by yourself.
:'''Grandma Hua:''' Better than the past when you had to trade something just to get a bite to eat...
:{{DIcon}} Exchange?
:'''Grandma Hua:''' Hmm... When I was younger, in another village, they had the habit of exchange.
:'''Grandma Hua:''' Exchange... What exactly are we exchanging...?
:'''Grandma Hua:''' I can't remember... Every time I think of the word "exchange", I get the heebie-jeebies...
:'''Grandma Hua:''' Forget it... I'm too old to remember anything...
{{Dialogue End}}
